headlines.title: Coda and Visa partner to deliver seamless and trusted gaming commerce across Southeast Asia
headlines.summary: Coda, a global leader in digital content monetisation and distribution, today announced a five-year partnership with Visa, a global leader in digital payments, to support the growth of gaming commerce across Southeast Asia.

headlines.title: UQPAY Deploys Visa Payment Passkey, Advancing the Next Generation of Agentic Payment Experience
headlines.summary: UQPAY has announced the production deployment of Visa Payment Passkey, becoming one of the earlier issuers in Asia Pacific to bring this capability into a live environment. It marks another step forward in UQPAY's work on payment security, user experience, and the foundations of intelligent commerce.

headlines.title: Visa (V) Warns Of Rapid Surge In AI Driven Payment Threats
headlines.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) warned of a rapid surge in AI-driven payment threats in its latest Biannual Threats Report released in 2026. The company is expanding AI-based fraud detection tools and increasing coordination with law enforcement agencies targeting global payments crime. Visa is rolling out Scan to Pay with Samsung Wallet across Asia Pacific and partnering with Airport Authority Hong Kong on an integrated air cargo payment solution.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
